This week, I went to the bank to deposit my paycheck. Unlike last week when I was a little hesitant to do my banking, I now felt much more confident. Although I seldomly go to the bank, I was able to complete all of the paperwork and deposit my paycheck with ease. I couldn't help but notice a striking difference between how I felt at the bank this week and the previous week, when I felt a bit nervous and hesitant. Although I kept my guard up, I was able to find the courage and strength I needed to open my account and get my money in without any issues. 

This week, I feel much more comfortable in my surroundings and with my tasks at the bank. Last week, as much as I enjoyed my time there, I wasn't able to focus much due to my jitters. I'm sure that part of my jitters stemmed from nerves at the idea of writing a big cheque for the bank, as I'm a bit superstitious in nature. However, this week, I was able to focus on writing the cheque without my initial hesitation. I feel like as a practical person, I need to continue this feeling forever, so that I no longer have that special fear. This week was a big step for me, both in terms of my own comfort at the bank and of staying focused on my writing, and I'm putting all my faith in it.
